fact: The Somali Ministry of Communication and Technology's EA-RDIP project unit sets out in its January 2026 manual a grievance mechanism whose channels will include telephone hotline, SMS and WhatsApp, email and online platforms, plus suggestion boxes, for complaints about the project; no case numbers are given.

Somalia's Ministry of Finance issued a World Bank-funded request for bids on 12 December 2024 to design, supply and commission a Citizen Engagement and Grievance Redress Mechanism platform, bids due 12 January 2025.
